create_ail_config: create an AILConfig dataclass instance with a custom direct RL batch size and discriminator batch size
configure_discriminator_optimizer: configure an AILConfig with a custom optax discriminator optimizer and replay table name
set_replay_buffer_sizes: set the min and max replay buffer sizes on an AILConfig for controlling replay capacity
compute_learner_batch_size: compute the per learner step batch size using get_per_learner_step_batch_size with a shared iterator config
validate_batch_size_alignment: validate that direct RL batch size is divisible by discriminator batch size using AILConfig post init assertion
